sources.title: X-Men Starjammers by Dave Cockrum collection

events.scope: X-Men: Spotlight on Starjammers #1–2 (1990), historical origin
events.documented_observation: Corsair helps rescue Hepzibah from Shi’ar captivity; the two later become romantic partners and life-bonded mates.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher secondary reconstruction; original panels not reviewed.

events.documented_observation: While the Starjammers help repel the Uncreated, Corsair overrides Hepzibah’s weapons station to stop her attacking a Shi’ar vessel.
events.evidence_limit: Specific action from unverified Marvel character biography; exact issue within mini-series unconfirmed.

events.scope: Starjammers founding backstory; Spotlight on Starjammers (1990) #1–2
events.documented_observation: Raza and Corsair fight Shi’ar jailers during Hepzibah’s rescue and escape together from the prison world.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher team history; no permanent friendship inferred from the rescue.

events.scope: Starjammers founding backstory; Spotlight on Starjammers (1990) #1–2
events.documented_observation: Ch’od and Raza look for their captive friend Hepzibah and help free her.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher team history; precise original panel not reviewed.

events.scope: Starjammers founding backstory; Spotlight on Starjammers (1990) #1–2
events.documented_observation: Ch’od helps Corsair defeat guards and free Hepzibah; they escape the prison colony together.
events.evidence_limit: Cooperative act, not merely shared membership.

events.documented_observation: Christopher and his wife Katherine-Anne are captured by the Shi’ar; D’ken kills Katherine after Christopher resists his attempt to claim her.
events.evidence_limit: Marriage and coercion summarized by publisher; exact sequence issue should be checked.

events.documented_observation: D’ken’s operative Davan Shakari, acting as Erik the Red, captures Lilandra and returns her to the Shi’ar court.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher biography; exact issue of capture within span pending panel review.

events.documented_observation: D’ken tasks Davan Shakari with preventing Lilandra from securing Xavier’s assistance.
events.evidence_limit: Explicit command relationship; no friendship implied.

events.documented_observation: Hussar joins the Imperial Guard faction siding with Samédàr against X-Men defending Lilandra, including after the coup is exposed.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher biography unverified; independent issue recap confirms Guard split but attribution to Hussar needs panel review.

events.documented_observation: Deathbird recruits Samédàr into the conspiracy to kill Lilandra and threaten Earth.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher accounts; collaboration is a coup, not proven friendship.

events.documented_observation: Lilandra sends Deathcry to protect the Avengers from Kree retaliation; Deathcry becomes an honorary Avenger.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher character history unverified; assignment period approximate.

events.documented_observation: T’cahr serves as an aide to Lilandra but is exposed as a D’ken loyalist during the Uncreated crisis.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher empire history; exact issue within mini-series not established.

events.documented_observation: Sikorsky and Moira MacTaggert clone a body for Brood-infected Charles Xavier and transfer his mind, saving him.
events.evidence_limit: Independent issue recap supplies procedure; publisher team history also reports Sikorsky saved Xavier.

events.scope: Shi’ar succession plots, 1990s; exact issue unresolved
events.documented_observation: Shakari and Crystal Claws try to manipulate D’ken’s illegitimate son Adam-X into claiming the Shi’ar throne.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher empire history; exact issue and Adam-X’s response unresolved.

events.documented_observation: Samédàr kills Chancellor Araki and obstructs communication that could stop the bombardment of Earth.
events.evidence_limit: Independent issue recap identifies killing; do not merge the murdered chancellor with later Araki clones.

events.scope: War of Kings #4–5 / War of Kings: Ascension #4 (2009)
events.documented_observation: Razor, controlling Chris Powell’s Darkhawk body, assassinates Lilandra during the attempt to restore her throne.
events.evidence_limit: Publisher biographies and issue synopsis; Razor and human host must remain separate identities.

identity_cautions: Araki refers to the chancellor murdered in Uncanny X-Men #157, not the later Araki clones or successors.
Razor is the Fraternity of Raptors entity, not its possessed human host Chris Powell.
Davan Shakari (Erik the Red) is distinct from Scott Summers using a similar disguise.
Deathcry civilian/birth name and Hussar civilian name are not established in the cited sources.
Hepzibah and the founding Starjammers accounts rely partly on Marvel pages marked crowd-sourced and unverified.
